messages:
deploy-bot: Release request created for hotfix/service-embed v2.3.1 -> production canary. Triggered by rachael. Change window: immediate. Reason: embedding latency regression in prod-eu.

maya (eng-release): quick heads-up — this is high-priority. repro + rollback validated?

rachael (pm): repro confirmed on canary traffic mirror. customers affected: 2 enterprise tenants. PR with fix: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 — release notes draft linked there.

liam (infra): infra ok for expedited path if we pin the eu GPU pool and set a temporary CB. I'll prepare the pin and a deployment annotation.

sam (oncall): oncall +1 for fastpath if rollout plan and rollback playbook are explicit. Need smoke test list and alert thresholds.

maya: propose plan: 1) pin gpu-pool-eu to hf-embed-v2, 2) canary 5% for 15m smoke tests, 3) promote to 50% for 30m, 4) promote to 100% if no regressions. Rollback conditions: error rate >1% for 5m OR p95 latency increase >200ms.

liam (infra): pin done — `kubectl annotate pool/gpu-pool-eu hotfix-pin=hf-embed-v2 --overwrite` and `kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu-pool-eu -o wide` shows expected capacity. Also applied `circuit-breaker: 0.01` on route for automatic fallback.

sam (oncall): smoke tests: 1) generate-embed smoke probe (1k samples), 2) kvcache-hit ratio check, 3) tail logs for OOM/kv-errors. I updated alerting: embed-error-rate >0.8% triggers pager.

maya: thanks. I'll request expedited approval: @sam @liam please react with :+1: to approve fastpath.

rachael (pm): PM signoff: I've reviewed customer impact and comms. +1 from me.

sam (oncall): +1 — oncall approves.

liam (infra): +1 — infra approves and will standby for immediate rollback ops.

maya: executing deploybot command: `/deploy hotfix/service-embed v2.3.1 --fastpath --pin=gpu-pool-eu --notes "hotfix: embed latency regression"`

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Initiating canary rollout: prod-eu canary -> 5% traffic. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/in/4970012345

sam (oncall): monitoring hooks are live. smoke probes started. initial latency looks stable.

maya: running smoke suite now. snippet: ```python
# quick smoke
r = client.embed("test")
assert len(r) == 768
```

deploy-bot: Canary health after 5m: OK (error_rate=0.12%, p95 latency delta=+18ms). Continuing to 15m.

sam (oncall): passing 15m smoke. No anomalies. Proceed to 50%?

maya: promoting to 50% now. Will monitor next 30m.

deploy-bot: Promoted to 50%. Canary ID: cb-4970012345-50pct.

rachael (pm): making a short release note for customers and ops channel. Link to final: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/hf-embed-v2.3.1

liam (infra): standing by. If rollback needed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-embed --to-revision=1767` and unpin pool.

sam (oncall): thresholds holding. No error spikes. p95 within SLA.

maya: no objections — planning promote to 100% in 25m unless someone calls hold.

rachael (pm): no hold. send customer comms after full rollout.

deploy-bot: Final promotion to 100% complete. All nodes serving v2.3.1. Pin remains until EOD.

maya: closing thread — hotfix deployed, pinned, release notes published. Will follow up with postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all :tada:
